scenes.text: Imagine lying on a freezing battlefield in 1862, wounded, waiting for help that might never come.
Suddenly, you look down at your open wounds and realize they are literally glowing in the dark with a faint blue light.
Even crazier, those with the glowing wounds healed much faster than the others, leading people to call it Angels Glow.
The freezing mud was home to a unique bioluminescent bacteria that actually produced natural antibiotics, killing off deadly infections and saving their lives.
